v001.note: NEEDS CONFIRMATION (my check, Oct 26). Parlor in the Round is a songwriter-round series at Bear Tooth Theatrepub in Anchorage, 1230 W 27th Ave. I only confirmed last year's edition: an Eventbrite listing for Nov 20, 2025, 'a night of stories and music,' no performers named. The Anchorage Daily News ran a 2026 Parlor in the Round item on Oct 14, but I couldn't open it. The Nov 19, 2026 date and the 275 + 125 seat figures are (per ChatGPT) and I could not verify them. It is a multi-writer round, so a duo would have to be invited into it, not booked as a headliner. Ask the theater at (907) 276-4200 (from ChatGPT). Remote state: only worth it if routed as part of a trip with several dates.

v003.note: POSSIBLE (my check, Oct 26). Denali Arts Council runs the Sheldon Community Arts Hangar in Talkeetna and presents a real season of ticketed shows. Feb 2026 included Tim Kliphuis and Jimmy Grant 'Django Duets' (Feb 6) and LowDown Brass Band (Feb 19), so a violin-and-guitar duo is in the same lane. Oct 31, 2026 Young Dubliners and Apr 18, 2027 Simon/Jenner Fox Band are (per ChatGPT), not re-verified; total seats unknown (ChatGPT says 48 balcony seats). Pitch a winter or spring slot and ask about fee, lodging and backline. Contact michelle@denaliartscouncil.org / 907-733-7929 (from ChatGPT). Remote state: only worth it if routed as part of a trip with several dates.

v104.note: POOR FIT (my check, Oct 26). HPR's Atherton studio is a lovely room, but the official page says it holds only about 40 people. The current Celebrate 808 series is Honeyfingers Nov 7, Maryanne Ito Nov 14, Skullboy Nov 21, all at 6 PM, and it is aimed at Hawaii-based artists. Artists apply through an online form on the HPR site, and no pay is published. Too small and too local to justify island travel unless you are already on Oahu. Contact mail@hawaiipublicradio.org / 808-955-8821 (from ChatGPT). Remote state: only worth it if routed as part of a trip with several dates.

v232.note: POOR FIT (my check, Oct 26). Sibyl Center in Stanley is a real, active presenter, but its 2026 season (June 13 to Oct 24, 12 shows, 7 PM, limited seating) is all classic country, tribute and oldies acts: Suzy Bogguss, Malpass Brothers, Everly Brothers Experience, Ronnie McDowell, Darryl Worley (Minot Daily News). That is not your singer-songwriter lane, and the season is over. Stanley is also far out in western ND. Only worth a call if you are already routed through the area: 701-629-1721 (from ChatGPT). Seats and pay unknown.
